title: Hypixel Bedwars Orbit Panorama
description: A panorama of a bedwars map for Hypixel fans!
body:
Ya know that Hypixel bedwars map, Orbit? Well this resource pack adds a panorama of it!![Panorama!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e72de0ffae764c4d64f1c6f35ae5f63d40f8de38_0.webp)

Perfect for hypixel or bedwars fans!

BTW: a panorama is that title screen background thing that usally has something to do with the minecraft version.
